basic_info.description: The perfect single-family home alternative in Noe Valley: 3bd/3.5ba, 2018-renovated house-like condo. Dedicated entrance, private 1-car garage, and decks on all levels offer a house-like feel. Approx. 3,309 SF (per graphic artist) spans 2 levels plus a loft with versatile space. The main level features seamless living, parlor, and dining areas, perfect for entertaining. A kitchen connected to an exclusive deck with a hot tub, 2 bedrooms, 2 baths, laundry, and ample storage complete this level. Upstairs, enjoy a master suite with views, an approx. 16-foot ceiling entertainment room under a skylight, and flex space for a 4th bedroom, office, or game room. Flat roof access allows for a potential rooftop deck with views. Beautiful period details including soaring coved ceilings with original medallions; hardwood floors throughout. Gas fireplace and AC provide year-round comfort. This smart home allows for app-controlled built-in speakers, AC, garage, lights, shades and doorbell. Pet-friendly 2-unit building with no weight limit. Walkable to 24th street retail, parks, and schools, with easy MUNI and tech shuttle access.
